decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's core handcrafted candle-arch expertise and prominently featured on the home page, it fits existing knowledge and should be improvable with normal workshop learning.
This product sits very near the firm's established Christmas-pyramid capabilities and its home-page prominence suggests enough initial confidence to retain it.

Although highlighted on the home page, the electronic and interchangeable-disc concept is relatively far from the firm's craft-based knowledge base, making learning and further improvement harder for a low-R&D traditional producer.
This accessory depends on the success of the distant electronic music-box line and was only mentioned rather than strongly promoted, so it is a likely candidate to be withdrawn.
As another niche add-on tied to the same distant electronic platform, it offers limited standalone value and strains absorptive capacity more than the firm's traditional woodcraft range.
A themed Christmas pyramid builds directly on the firm's established seasonal craftsmanship and should be easy to understand, produce, and refine within existing capabilities.
